name: What are the signs of a hidden toilet leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a hidden toilet leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden toilet leaks often manifest subtly, making them difficult to detect without careful observation. Common signs include a constantly running toilet, phantom flushing (when the toilet flushes itself without being used), or a sudden increase in your water bill. You might also notice water stains on the ceiling below the bathroom or a musty odor near the toilet. For a simple test, add food coloring to the tank; if it appears in the bowl without flushing, you have a leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include a constantly running toilet, phantom flushing, increased water bills, water stains below the bathroom, or musty odors.
